context: A mom listens to her young son chatter about school
purpose: Teach: そこら/やって来/づらい/いちいち/ごとく/馴染み/飛び出し/目覚め

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今日ね、朝の目覚めがすっごく良くてさ、学校まで走って行ったんだよ!
lines.en: Mom, this morning I woke up super refreshed, and I ran all the way to school!
lines.style: Excited child rapid-fire chatter, breathless and proud.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: へえ、すごいじゃない。そこら中の子が眠そうにしてる時間でしょ?
lines.en: Wow, that's great. Isn't that the time when kids everywhere are still sleepy?
lines.style: Warm maternal tone, gently teasing while listening attentively.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: そうそう!でね、教室入ったらタケシ君が窓から飛び出してきて、ビックリしちゃった!
lines.en: Yeah yeah! And then when I walked into the classroom, Takeshi jumped out from behind the window and totally startled me!
lines.style: Animated storytelling, gesturing with hands and giggling between words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あらあら、お馴染みのいたずらっ子ねえ。先生に怒られなかった?
lines.en: Oh my, that familiar little prankster again. Didn't the teacher scold him?
lines.style: Amused mother's chuckle, half exasperated half charmed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 先生はいちいち怒らないよ。でもタケシ君が嵐のごとく走り回るから、ちょっと注意しづらいんだって
lines.en: The teacher doesn't get mad every single time. But she says Takeshi runs around like a storm, so it's a bit hard to scold him.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact child explanation, mimicking the teacher's words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、難しい年頃なのよ。それで給食の時間はどうだったの?
lines.en: Haha, it's a tricky age. So how was lunch time then?
lines.style: Soft laugh, encouraging the child to keep talking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: あ、そうだ!新しい転校生がやって来て、隣の席に座ったんだ。優しそうな子だったよ
lines.en: Oh, that's right! A new transfer student arrived and sat next to me. They seemed really nice.
lines.style: Sudden burst of remembered news, eyes lighting up.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あら素敵。明日は仲良く話しかけてあげなさいね
lines.en: Oh how lovely. Make sure you talk to them nicely tomorrow, okay?
lines.style: Gentle motherly encouragement, soft and supportive.
